brand_gaps: No AntaraX credit line ('AX Frame · by AntaraX') in the app chrome; the sidebar sub-line reads 'Digital asset ledger'. Only the sign-in page says 'AX Frame by AntaraX' (09, products/frame.md Credit lines).
No Help item in the nav and no /guide or /help routes; help is 'Support & FAQ' inside the profile menu (13 §8).

'Connect your AI' pinned item and the AI quick start use hard-coded violet #7A5AF8 / #F6F3FF / #EFE9FF (desktop.css:95-97, quickstart/illustrations.tsx:145), outside the Frame palette and against the repo's 'tokens, never hex in a component' rule. Avatar gradient also hard-codes #3B82F6.
Customer account is called 'Workspace' in the profile menu and screen; 13 §1 says 'organisation' on settings and billing. Profile menu says 'Billing', the page says 'Plan & Billing'.
No plan name (Seed / Nova) anywhere in the shell chrome; only inside Billing.
AXLE focus ring is #4D84FE (admin.css:28); 13 §10 asks for the AntaraX-blue #0459F7 ring in every product.

AXLE mobile bug: the <=860px rule `.adm-main{padding:64px 16px 40px}` (admin.css:62) is overridden by the later `.adm-main{padding:28px 34px 48px}` (admin.css:106), so the fixed hamburger sits on top of every page title on phones (see 03c).
AXLE nav has no icons while the customer nav does; AXLE shell has no sign-out (only 'Back to AX Frame').
AXLE sign-in and denied page say 'AUTHORIZED STAFF ONLY' (US spelling; British is 'authorised', 13 §7).
AXLE host is axle-antarax.vercel.app, not axle.antarax.ai (13 §2). §6 asks for 'the AntaraX A in the corner'; AXLE shows the Frame mark (A + Frame icon), which is close.
Accessibility: no aria-current on desktop nav, mobile tabs or AXLE links; the mobile '+' tab button has no accessible name; no axe check in CI (13 §10).
Em dashes throughout page descriptions in pageMeta.ts and AXLE subtitles (the brand voice audit flags em dashes).

Docs drift: AXF-AXLE-THEME.md (12 Jul 2026) still describes a dark rail over a light canvas, ink #0E1420 and 'REKA operator console'; the shipped AXLE is dark-only (#071233). The brand kit's products/frame.md 'Gaps' list (#0062FB primary, orange accent) is also out of date: the repo already uses Frame blue #074AF8 and keeps orange in AXLE only.
notes: One Next.js app serves the customer app and AXLE. The customer app is a single client component (src/App.tsx) that switches screens by state and ?v= (no per-screen routes); desktop vs phone is a whole-shell swap at 860px (two altitudes: desktop Ledger, phone Insight). Nav labels/icons come from one registry, src/features/shell/pageMeta.ts. AXLE has two modes (Dashboard / R8) with separate nav sets. Other non-dashboard surfaces not inventoried in depth: public landing (/), project guest view (/shared, /guest/[token]), public share (/share/[token]), onboarding, closed-pilot page. Static mocks (axf-hero.html, axf-stack-composer.html, docs/mock/map-v2) are specs, not the shipped nav.
